reason: A right-side DeepSeek Harness workspace panel for browsing, previewing, searching, and reviewing workspace files and captured DSH changes alongside the conversation.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供右侧文件工作区，用于浏览、预览、搜索文件并查看捕获的 DSH 修改。
summaries.en: Provides a right-side DeepSeek Harness file workspace for browsing, previewing, searching, and reviewing captured DSH changes.

capabilities: Displays captured DSH write and edit diffs
Provides a file tree, tabs, path copying, search, find, and line navigation
Inserts file paths and selected preview lines into the composer
Listens to DSH tool and code-dispatch events
